_comment: Pinned downloads for 'python prepare_release.py fetch-tools'. Paths are relative to the repo root. An empty sha256 is filled in (and must then be committed) by the first successful fetch.

vc_runtime._comment: App-local Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime (x64), copied from %SystemRoot%\System32 next to tools/python/python.exe. Venvs made with 'python -m venv' run that base python.exe as the real process, so the DLL loader finds these first (torch's c10.dll and Pixal3D's native modules import MSVCP140.dll).
